parse.text:
Units must be FINANCED when admitted.
Maximum invoice tenor is 90 days.
Units must have at least 15 days remaining to maturity.
Units must have no more than 2 transfers.
Buyer rating must be A- or better.
Maximum integrity ring score is 700.
No resolved buyer group may exceed 10 percent of exposure.
Seller concentration may not exceed 5 percent of exposure.
The pool must contain at least 100 live units.
The servicer shall use reasonable efforts to collect receivables.

rules.sourceSpan: Units must be FINANCED when admitted.
rules.readBack: A unit must be FINANCED when it is added to the pool.
ambiguities: 'Admitted' is read as the moment the unit is added to the pool.

rules.readBack: The invoice's original tenor may be at most 90 days.

rules.sourceSpan: Units must have at least 15 days remaining to maturity.
rules.readBack: At least 15 days must remain to maturity when the unit is pooled.

rules.sourceSpan: Units must have no more than 2 transfers.
rules.readBack: A unit may have been re-discounted at most 2 times.

rules.sourceSpan: Buyer rating must be A- or better.
rules.readBack: The buyer must be rated A- or better.
ambiguities: Ratings come from a synthetic scale and travel with the pinned evidence set.

rules.readBack: A unit's evidence score may be at most 700, unless a reviewer clears it.
ambiguities: The document says 'ring score'. It is mapped to the evidence score, which is evidence for a human reviewer, not a fraud verdict.

rules.sourceSpan: No resolved buyer group may exceed 10 percent of exposure.
rules.readBack: No resolved buyer group may be more than 10% of the pool's face value.
ambiguities: 'Exposure' is not defined. This build measures concentration on face value; confirm the basis.

rules.sourceSpan: Seller concentration may not exceed 5 percent of exposure.
rules.readBack: No single seller may be more than 5% of the pool's face value.
ambiguities: 'Exposure' is not defined. This build measures concentration on face value; confirm the basis.

rules.sourceSpan: The pool must contain at least 100 live units.
rules.readBack: The pool must hold at least 100 units when it is sealed.
ambiguities: 'Live' is read as pooled and not yet settled or defaulted. The size check runs once, when the pool is sealed.

unsupported.span: The servicer shall use reasonable efforts to collect receivables.
unsupported.reason: No rule in the closed vocabulary matches this clause.
